privacy.label: Data Security
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Find out how we protect your data and respect your privacy in the world of virtual racing.
privacy.p1: The administrator of your personal data is DriveAndAlive Studio. We collect your data to ensure the proper functioning of the game's features, to calculate real-time leaderboards, and to store your account information on secure servers.
privacy.p2: During your gameplay, we collect the minimum necessary information:
privacy.li2_1: Your nickname in the game, the email address used for registration, and your password in an encrypted form (hash).
privacy.li2_2: Information about your runs, times achieved, earned achievements, and selected tracks.
privacy.li2_3: Information about the end device you use the app from (e.g., device model, system version), strictly for optimization and bug-fixing purposes.
privacy.h3: How do we use your data?
privacy.p3: The collected information is used solely to:
privacy.li3_1: Sync with the global leaderboard and calculate points on your account.
privacy.li3_2: Store badges, game settings, and potential Cloud Save backups.
privacy.li3_3: Perform statistical analysis to identify which tracks may need difficulty adjustments for the player community.
privacy.h4: Who has access to your data?
privacy.p4: We ensure the highest service standards – your data will never be resold to affiliated companies. We solely use technologies from verified cloud providers operating within the EEA territory.
privacy.p5: After logging in, as an authorized user, you have the right to request at any time a package of all telemetry collected about you, as well as to request the complete, irreversible deletion of your profile. Privacy contact: email

cookies.label: Tracking Settings
cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: Full transparency regarding the storage of small data files on your device.
cookies.p1: Cookies are computer data, specifically text files, that are stored on the User's end device and are intended for the use of the Service's web pages. Cookies usually contain the website's name, their storage time on the device, and a unique authentication identifier to connect with your mobile game wallet.
cookies.p2: The Service uses two fundamental mechanisms to manage User authentication:
cookies.li2_1: These enable the proper functioning of the login mechanism and profile settings (the "daa_user" session). Without them, your session would expire every time you refresh the page.
cookies.li2_2: We track – using anonymized tools – traffic on specific subpages, for example, to know if a new map update in the Map Creator tab is of interest to you.
cookies.p3: Since the game is still in development, it uses simple keys relying on the browser's Local Storage interface. This mechanism allows your browser to read declared preferences, such as a selected avatar. Clearing your history also results in the loss of local keys – this is entirely dependent on your browsing preferences at the source.
cookies.p4: Web browsing applications by default allow the storage of cookies. You can independently decide to refuse and manually block files for the portal in your browser's properties, but bear in mind that this will lead to the immediate closure of the active user session.

terms.label: Project Legal Framework
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: General terms and conditions for the provision of the web platform and the DriveAndAlive game.
terms.p1: These Terms of Service come into effect immediately upon interacting with the services associated with the project and define the rules for using the services provided via the portal for exchanging databases and user tables, commonly referred to as: DriveAndAlive.
terms.li2_1: Registration on the Service is voluntary and completely free.
terms.li2_2: The Player is obliged to use a username (nickname) that is not vulgar, offensive, or infringing on the personal rights of others, under the penalty of pausing progress on the profile and the permanent deletion of the account by the Administration.
terms.li2_3: One User should register only one main Account, linked to the mobile version installed on the local operating equipment.
terms.p3_1: DriveAndAlive fully celebrates esports mechanics and the skills honed by its players over weeks. Therefore, it is strictly forbidden to:
terms.li3_1: Use unofficial scripts or background programs generating additional, fictitious points on rally tracks.
terms.li3_2: Alter the game's binary codes to reduce gravity or artificially increase vehicle power to break the leaderboard limiters.
terms.p3_2: Penalties for such actions are permanent and enforce a lifelong server exclusion (a Hard-Ban systemic model).
terms.p4: Map Creator allows players to create their own roads. By creating rally tracks, you agree to grant us a free, non-exclusive license to uninterruptedly serve and host them on global internal platform servers for the entire affiliated community!
terms.p5: The creators reserve the right to perform unannounced maintenance on the platform to implement subsequent key network fixes with server databases associated with the game ranking tables. We do our best to ensure these downtimes occur only during night hours.
